<!--
StatixAgent aims to stay featherweight and isolated (one binary, one machine,
one private bot, no central server, no database). Proposals are weighed against
footprint and scope — please describe the problem first, not just the solution.
-->

## Problem / motivation

What are you trying to accomplish, and where does StatixAgent fall short today?

## Proposed change

What you'd like it to do.

## Alternatives considered

Other ways to solve the problem, and why the proposal is better.

## Scope & footprint

How this fits the "featherweight and isolated" goals (new dependencies,
background work, state, privileges). If it stretches them, make the case.

## Additional context

Anything else — links, examples, related issues.
